title: Radiofrequency treatment of spine joints
also: burning the nerve in the back
what: Using a thin needle with an electric current, the doctor heats the tiny nerves that carry pain from the spine joints. The pain gets weaker.
why: For long-lasting neck or lower back pain from the spine joints, when a trial block helped.
duration: the procedure usually takes 30 to 90 minutes; watching afterward is about an hour
tell_doctor: Blood-thinning medicines. The doctor will say what to stop and when
A pacemaker or other device in your body
Fever or infection the day before

prepare.title: Trial block
prepare.text: Usually a trial injection is done first. If the pain eased, the procedure is done.

prepare.title: Images
prepare.text: Bring your spine MRI or CT.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually a light meal is fine. If sedation is planned, ask the clinic about timing.

prepare.title: Getting home
prepare.text: Ask someone to take you home.

steps: You lie on your stomach, or on your back for the neck
The skin is cleaned and numbed
Under X-ray, the doctor guides thin needles to the nerves
The spot is tested with a weak current. You may feel tingling
The needle tip is heated and the nerve stops carrying pain
The needles are removed and a plaster is applied
feel: During testing you may feel tingling or muscle twitching
For a few days or weeks afterward, burning or aching at the site
after: Take it easy today and do not drive
The effect usually comes after 2 to 4 weeks
Keep up your exercise therapy. It helps keep the result
red_flags: Fever above 38, redness and swelling at the injection sites
Growing weakness or numbness in an arm or leg: call your doctor
You cannot pass urine or hold it: call your local emergency number

faq.a: Over time the nerve can recover and the pain can return. Then the procedure is sometimes repeated.
Only tiny nerves that carry joint pain are heated. The muscles of the legs and arms are usually not affected.

reminders.text: Back procedure tomorrow. Bring your images and list of medicines. Ask someone to take you home.
